rationale: Price is at 98.5% of today's range and within 0.08% of the session high after a large intraday rally, creating an extremely unfavorable risk/reward for a long entry near resistance. A short is unattractive because the 1-minute tape shows persistent buying pressure with price holding near highs on elevated relative volume (6.17x), and the convertible note offering news — while dilutive — is already 930 minutes old and apparently absorbed. With SPY down 0.91% and VIXY up 3.73%, the broad market headwind adds uncertainty; the cleanest action is to wait for a cleaner setup rather than chase either direction at an extended extreme.
